statement: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp. For every fixed $`1\lt p\lt \infty`$ and distortion D > 1, every n-point subset of real Lp embeds into $`\ell_p^d`$ with distortion at most D and dimension $`d=n^{o(1)}`$, answering Naor's sublinear-dimension question for p ≠ 2. In contrast, exact embeddings require worst-case dimension $`\Theta(n^2)`$ when p ≠ 2.
